summary: Plan GIS implementation with QGIS, GeoPackage and spatial data checks. Build a readiness review and rollout roadmap. Explore the course.
lede: GIS implementation helps planning and spatial-data teams turn user needs and existing datasets into workable mapping workflows. For GIS officers, urban planning analysts and project leads, the course covers assessing readiness, documenting requirements and checking spatial-data quality, then configuring reusable QGIS projects and GeoPackage structures. Participants also map responsibilities and plan a phased rollout, producing practical materials to support implementation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for spatial data, GIS workflows or the planning decisions those systems support, including teams applying maps to urban planning.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with maps, spatial data or planning workflows is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use QGIS and supplied sample spatial datasets.
